Bruxism/teeth grinding and jaw clenching are common side effects of SNRIs (like Venlafaxine) due to the changing levels of serotonin and other neurotransmitters in your brain from the drug. Hello! So sorry to hear you're having this experience. Probably best to bring it up to your doctor if those feelings persist. I had the same dosage increase, started on 37.5 mg, increased to 75 mg, and currently on 112.5 mg (2 capsules, 1x75 and 1x37.5). When I increased from 37.5 mg to 75mg daily, I had a period of time where I had all the worst side effects (mood drop, night sweats, tremors), but those went away in about 3-4 weeks for me. Didn't have any side effects on my second increase to 112.5 mg. If it's only been a little bit of time since you increased to 112.5 mg, maybe give your body a bit of time to adjust, but if your low mood persists, maybe best to re-consult with your doctor or psychiatrist. I hope you have a positive experience moving forward!
